listing.name: Super Mario Bros. Wonder (SuperMarioWonderRecomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Super Mario Bros. Wonder port translating AArch64 code to C++ with NVN-to-Vulkan/MoltenVK support. Apple hosting does not imply direct ARM execution. The project reports the title, selection, opening, world map and course 1-1 rendering, with a 60 FPS headless test but visible-window stretches at 35–40 FPS. Glitch fixes and full-game progress are unconfirmed. There are no fixed releases: source preparation translates code/shaders and builds locally with your own files and development tools. Apple Silicon Mac is the reference platform; Windows x64 needs Vulkan 1.3 and the documented GPUs, while Android ARM64 is separate. Linux is not ported, lacking platform/memguard/CMake support. Use your own version 1.0.0 title 010015100B514000 ExeFS/RomFS, keys and firmware. Generated code, shaders and fonts stay private; exact region/hashes are unconfirmed. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
